title: Kigali connects water, mobility, waste and wetland services
summary: The new city account retains administrative boundaries, external water dependencies, transport delivery and livelihood concerns, waste-measurement limits and restoration stages. Eligibility reaches 100 projects and 70 places; older-content completion and release gates remain separate.
evidence_note: Seven primary English HTML sources inspected November 22. Publication and construction periods remain distinct from future capacity, passenger forecasts and undated restoration claims. No additional project identity, comparable series or blanket city-service acceptance.
publication_effect: Local source integration only. Historical inputs, prior cohorts, all 34 readings and cycle identities remain intact. No comparable outcome-series admission, production acceptance, Git publication, deployment, launch or stewardship completion is created.
